mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_payment (invoice_id, pay_type_cd, pay_dt, amount, method_cd, bank_cd, bank_account, counterpart_nm, memo, approval_doc_id, reg_user_id) VALUES (#{invoiceId}, #{payTypeCd}, COALESCE(#{payDt}, CURRENT_DATE), #{amount}, COALESCE(#{methodCd}, 'BANK_TRANSFER'), #{bankCd}, #{bankAccount}, #{counterpartNm}, #{memo}, #{approvalDocId}, #{regUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gw_payment WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} ORDER BY pay_dt
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM gw_payment WHERE pay_type_cd = #{payTypeCd}
